I publish here a part of a detailed monograph on Myconos, my birth- 
place, written years ago, when I was a student; it also contains its ancient 
coins, which are regarded as very rare, just to give a sample of the nu- 
mismatic richness of the humble Cyclades and its importance for the ar- 
chaeology of the islands in general.

5. Sestini also reports in Classes générales, second edition, p. 56 —
